provenance.paper_title: Robo-Cortex: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent via Dual-Grain Cognitive Memory and Autonomous Knowledge Induction

evidence.paraphrase: State transitions are written; AKI distills experience into heuristics. planning loop uses reflective/principle memories and induced heuristics.
AKI updates heuristics online across episodes. For Robo-Cortex, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of strategy / trajectory memory.
During operation, Robo-Cortex applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to strategy / trajectory memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (strategy / trajectory memory) changes through abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
